## The Best Great Question Alternatives


Outgrowing Great Question? Compare 7 alternatives for research operations, UX and product teams, including Rally, User Interviews, Respondent and Maze.

The best Great Question alternatives in 2026 are Rally, User Interviews, Ethnio, Respondent, Maze, UserTesting and Qualtrics. Rally is the best-in-class choice for research operations, UX and product teams that want more people talking to customers under rules researchers control. The right pick depends on whether you need a participant CRM, an external panel or a testing tool.


## Why are teams switching from Great Question?


Great Question is trying to be every research tool at once: recruiting, CRM, surveys, interviews, AI moderation, unmoderated tests, card sorting, tree testing, focus groups and a repository. That works for a small team getting started. As research spreads across a company, the trade-offs get harder to live with.


**Enterprise basics come at Enterprise prices.** Salesforce and Snowflake sync, SSO, custom consent, audit logs and MCP access all sit in Great Question's custom-priced Enterprise plan, and its self-serve plan stops at five seats, according to its[pricing page](https://www.greatquestion.com/pricing) . HIPAA and AI-moderated interviews are add-ons on top of that. If your company runs on Salesforce or has a security review, you're buying Enterprise from day one.


**All-in-one means giving up tools your team chose.** Great Question builds its own versions of the testing, analysis and repository tools you may already run. Moving to it means migrating studies, retraining teams and replacing tools like Maze or UserTesting that people picked for a reason.


**Contact rules have to hold when dozens of people can send.** Once PMs and designers reach customers directly, one over-contacted account becomes a problem for the account team. You need cooldowns, do-not-contact rules and blocklists that apply automatically on every send, with a record of every override. Ask any vendor to show you exactly how that works before you sign.


**AI has to work where your team already works.** Great Question includes MCP access with its Enterprise plan. If your PMs live in Claude or Slack, check what it takes to give them access on the plan you can afford.


**Enterprise proof matters.** On G2, Great Question has[23 reviews to Rally's 77](https://www.g2.com/compare/great-question-vs-rally-uxr) , and Rally scores higher on ease of use (9.2 vs. 8.8) and quality of support (9.9 vs. 9.7).


## What should you look for in a Great Question alternative?


Look for a platform that makes the right way to reach customers the easy way. Four questions sort the options quickly.


1. **Your own customers or an external panel?** Participant CRMs manage people you already have. Panels supply people you don't. The best tools do both.
2. **Who will run studies?** If PMs and designers will recruit, rules that apply automatically matter more than any single feature.
3. **Where does your team work?** The strongest tools now run inside Slack, Claude and other AI assistants. Check which plans include it.
4. **Which tools are you keeping?** A platform that connects to your testing and repository tools saves a migration.

## 1. Rally: best-in-class for research operations, UX and product teams


Rally is the best-in-class platform for teams that want every PM, designer and researcher talking to customers without losing control of who gets contacted. Rally is the system your company uses to talk to its own customers safely, and its mission is short: "End manual recruitment."


**Recruitment runs itself from where your team works.** The Rally Agent builds a study from your approved templates, then handles audience, outreach, screening, scheduling and incentives. Teams use it in the Rally app or in Slack by mentioning @Rally. Rally MCP brings the same system into Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients, and every Rally plan includes read-only Rally MCP access.


**Governance is built in.** Cooldowns, blocklists, do-not-contact rules and opt-outs are[enforced on every send](https://rallyuxr.com/agent) , whether a researcher, a PM or the agent sends it. Overrides need permission and a recorded reason, and blocklists and opt-outs can't be overridden at all. As one Calendly researcher[put it](https://www.rallyuxr.com/post/how-calendly-is-using-rallys-mcp-to-find-prior-research-enforce-standards-and-enable-everyone) , "The standards are enforced by the system, not by a person."


**Your customer data stays connected.** Rally syncs with[Salesforce](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/7509076234-salesforce) ,[Snowflake](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/3267975780-snowflake) and[BigQuery](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/6913902093-bigquery) , with two-way sync available on each. Incentives reach participants in 200+ countries.


**Your best-in-class stack stays intact.** Rally recruits for tests in[Maze, UserTesting, UserZoom, Ballpark, Outset, Listen Labs and Voicepanel](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/6353607009-create-an-unmoderated-test-study) , runs survey studies with[Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey or Typeform](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/4886683447-create-a-survey-study) , and works with repository tools like Marvin. When you need people outside your customer base, Rally recruits from Respondent and User Interviews at[published per-participant rates](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/6023855694-creating-studies-with-external-panel-recruitment) , charged only for participants who complete the study.


**The results are public.** MongoDB has 70+ PMs and designers running research with Rally, Earnest launches a study in one day instead of two to three weeks, and Faire cut recruitment time by 85%, according to Rally's[customer stories](https://www.rallyuxr.com/customers) . Rally rates 4.8 out of 5 on G2.

## 2. User Interviews: best for external panel recruiting


User Interviews pairs a large external panel with Research Hub, a CRM for your own participants. UserTesting[acquired User Interviews](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260107716032/en/UserTesting-Acquires-User-Interviews-to-Strengthen-the-Industrys-Most-Comprehensive-Customer-Insights-Solution-for-the-AI-Era) in January 2026, and the parent company now goes by Auros. Recruiting is priced per completed session, and Research Hub pricing comes through a demo.


### What's the difference between Rally and User Interviews?


User Interviews is built around its external panel, with Research Hub as a CRM on the side. Rally is built around your own customers: a participant CRM, contact rules enforced on every send and the Rally Agent, which runs recruitment from the Rally app or Slack.


**Does Rally integrate with User Interviews?** Yes. Rally[recruits from the User Interviews panel](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/6023855694-creating-studies-with-external-panel-recruitment) inside a Rally study when you need people outside your customer base.


## 3. Ethnio: best for intercept recruiting from your site or app


Ethnio recruits visitors in the moment through web, iOS and Android intercepts, with scheduling and global incentive payouts built in. Its Pro plan is $82 per seat per month and covers a panel of up to 10,000 participants, per its[pricing page](https://ethn.io/pricing) . The Ethnio Pool external panel and unlimited panel size come with Enterprise.


### What's the difference between Rally and Ethnio?


Ethnio is strongest at catching visitors in the moment with web and app intercepts, priced per seat. Rally is built for running research across many teams: a participant CRM that syncs with Salesforce, Snowflake and BigQuery, contact rules enforced on every send and an agent that runs recruitment end to end.


**Does Rally integrate with Ethnio?** No. Rally grows your panel through signup forms and syncs from Salesforce, Snowflake and BigQuery.


## 4. Respondent: external panel for B2B and professional recruiting


Respondent is an external panel of 4.3M+ verified participants, priced per completed session: $40 to $80 for moderated sessions and $25 to $40 for unmoderated, per its[pricing page](https://www.respondent.io/pricing) . Managing your own customers isn't its focus, so many teams pair it with a participant CRM.


### What's the difference between Rally and Respondent?


Respondent supplies new participants from its external panel. Rally manages the customers you already have and the rules for contacting them, so the two work best together.


**Does Rally integrate with Respondent?** Yes. Rally[recruits from the Respondent panel](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/6023855694-creating-studies-with-external-panel-recruitment) inside a Rally study, with consent forms, rescheduling and participant chat handled in Rally, and you pay only for participants who complete the study.


## 5. Maze: best for unmoderated and AI-moderated testing


Maze is a testing platform with a built-in panel, prototype testing and an AI moderator. You can share test links with your own users at no panel cost. It doesn't offer a CRM for your own participants, and its MCP is available to Enterprise teams, per its[product updates](https://maze.co/product-updates/en/release-roundup-august-2026) .


### What's the difference between Rally and Maze?


Maze runs the test: prototypes, unmoderated studies and AI-moderated sessions. Rally gets the right people into it, from your own customers or an external panel, under the contact rules your researchers set.


**Does Rally integrate with Maze?** Yes. Participants are recruited, screened and paid through Rally and[complete the test in Maze](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/6353607009-create-an-unmoderated-test-study) , and their progress is tracked back in Rally.


## 6. UserTesting: best for high-volume testing


UserTesting runs moderated and unmoderated tests on its own panel, with AI summaries and AI moderation. Its[plans](https://www.usertesting.com/plans) are sales-led, with either test-based or team-based pricing. It's a testing platform first, so participant operations for your own customers aren't its focus.


UserTesting is also a Rally customer. It runs its own customer panel on Rally and cut recruitment timelines from one to two weeks to 2.4 days, with a 104% fill rate, according to[UserTesting's panel story](https://www.rallyuxr.com/case-study/usertesting) .


### What's the difference between Rally and UserTesting?


UserTesting is a testing platform with its own large panel. Rally manages your own customers and the rules for reaching them, and recruits them into the tests you run.


**Does Rally integrate with UserTesting?** Yes. With the[Rally and UserTesting integration](https://rallyuxr.com/changelog/rally-usertesting-partnership-integration-launch) , you recruit your own customers in Rally, send screeners, invites and incentives, and run the test in UserTesting or UserZoom.


## 7. Qualtrics: best for survey-heavy teams already on Qualtrics


Qualtrics brings surveys, panels in 200+ markets and customer research communities into one enterprise suite, per its[panel management page](https://www.qualtrics.com/strategy/panel-management/) . Pricing is usage-based and quoted by sales. Interview scheduling and incentive operations aren't described on its research pages.


### What's the difference between Rally and Qualtrics?


Qualtrics is a survey and experience management suite. Rally runs the participant side of research across interviews, surveys and tests: recruiting, scheduling, incentives and contact rules.


**Does Rally integrate with Qualtrics?** Yes. A Rally survey study can[use a connected Qualtrics survey](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/4886683447-create-a-survey-study) , and Rally updates each participant's status when they submit.


## What about AI-moderated interview tools like Outset, Listen Labs and Voicepanel?


AI-moderated interview tools such as Outset, Listen Labs, Voicepanel and Dialogue replace one part of Great Question: its AI-moderated interviews, which Great Question sells as an[Enterprise add-on](https://www.greatquestion.com/features/ai-moderated-interviews) . They run the interview and the synthesis. They don't manage your participants, enforce contact rules or pay incentives across studies.


That makes them a strong pair with Rally. Rally recruits and screens participants, sends incentives and tracks completion, and the interview runs in the AI tool your team prefers. Rally[integrates with Outset, Listen Labs, Voicepanel and Dialogue](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/7226076457-integrations-overview) , so you can recruit from your own customers or an external panel and keep every participant's history in one place.


If AI-moderated interviews were the main reason you used Great Question, pairing one of these tools with Rally covers the interview and keeps your recruiting and rules in one system.


## Frequently asked questions


### What is the best alternative to Great Question?


Rally is the best alternative to Great Question for research operations, UX and product teams at growing companies. It combines a participant CRM, governance that applies on every send, and the Rally Agent, which runs recruitment from the Rally app or Slack. For an external panel on its own, Respondent and User Interviews are strong choices.


### Is Rally better than Great Question?


For teams scaling research beyond one research team, yes. Rally enforces contact rules automatically, syncs two ways with Salesforce, Snowflake and BigQuery, and includes read-only Rally MCP access on every plan. Great Question suits teams that want native card sorting, tree testing and a repository in one product.


### What is the best research operations platform for enterprise teams?


Rally is the best-in-class research operations platform for enterprise teams. Companies including Google, Meta, Figma, MongoDB and Ramp use Rally to manage participants, enforce contact rules and run recruitment across research, UX and product teams.


### What is the best tool for PMs and designers to recruit their own customers?


Rally lets PMs and designers recruit their own customers through the Rally Agent in the Rally app or Slack, using templates and rules researchers set. Researchers keep control of who can be contacted and how often, and PMs get a study running without learning research operations.


### Which user research tools work with Claude or other AI assistants?


Rally MCP connects to Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients, and every Rally plan includes read-only access. Great Question and Maze include MCP with their Enterprise plans. Ethnio offers an MCP server, and User Interviews and UserTesting MCP servers launched in early access in September 2026.


### Can I keep my existing testing tools if I leave Great Question?


Yes, with Rally. Rally recruits participants for tests in Maze, UserTesting, UserZoom, Ballpark, Outset, Listen Labs and Voicepanel, runs surveys with Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey or Typeform, and works with repository tools like Marvin. Your recruiting, rules and participant history stay in Rally while tests run in the tools your team already uses.


### Which research tools does Rally integrate with?


Rally integrates with the User Interviews and Respondent panels for external recruiting; Maze, UserTesting, UserZoom, Ballpark, Outset, Listen Labs, Voicepanel and Dialogue for tests and AI-moderated interviews; Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey and Typeform for surveys; and Salesforce, Snowflake and BigQuery for customer data. The full list is in Rally's[integrations overview](https://help.rallyuxr.com/articles/7226076457-integrations-overview) .


### Can I run AI-moderated interviews with Rally?


Yes, through Rally's integrations with Outset, Listen Labs, Voicepanel and Dialogue. Rally recruits and screens participants from your own customers or an external panel, sends incentives and tracks completion. The AI-moderated interview runs in the tool you choose, and every participant's history stays in Rally.


### How do I switch from Great Question to Rally?


Bring your participants into Rally by CSV import or by connecting Salesforce, Snowflake or BigQuery. Then set your contact rules and study templates once, so every study after that follows them automatically. Book a demo to plan the move with Rally's team.

Write down who will run studies next year, where they work and which tools you're keeping. That list will point you to the right platform faster than any feature grid.


If more of your team will be talking to customers, Rally gives them an agent that handles recruitment and rules researchers control.[Book a demo](https://www.rallyuxr.com/demo) to see it with your own studies.
